# docs.langchain.com documentation — Langsmith — Overview — Part 301

> 60 page(s) of docs.langchain.com documentation — Langsmith — Overview under Part 301. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Part 301

- [Minimum versions for self-hosting dependencies](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-dependency-versions.md): This page lists the minimum supported versions for the databases, tools, and infrastructure used by self-hosted LangSmith.
- [Disaster recovery for self-hosted LangSmith](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-disaster-recovery.md): This page describes how to plan, configure, and operate disaster recovery (DR) for self-hosted LangSmith Observability and Evaluation.
- [Egress for billing and operational telemetry](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-egress.md): This page only applies to customers who are not running in offline (air-gapped) mode and assumes you are using a self-hosted LangSmith instance serving version 0.9.0 or later.
- [Configure environment variables in the Helm chart](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-environment-variables.md): The LangSmith Helm chart provides two ways to inject environment variables into services: `commonEnv` and `extraEnv`.
- [Connect to an external ClickHouse database](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-external-clickhouse.md): ClickHouse is a high-performance, column-oriented database system. It allows for fast ingestion of data and is optimized for analytical queries.
- [Connect to an external PostgreSQL database](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-external-postgres.md): LangSmith uses a PostgreSQL database as the primary data store for transactional workloads and operational data (almost everything besides runs).
- [Connect to an external Redis or Valkey database](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-external-redis.md): LangSmith uses Redis to back our queuing/caching operations. By default, LangSmith Self-Hosted will use an internal Redis instance.
- [FIPS-compliant images](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-fips.md): FIPS and airgapped LangSmith deployments require a conversation with your LangChain account executive before rollout.
- [Create an Ingress for installations (Kubernetes)](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ingress.md): By default, LangSmith will provision a LoadBalancer service for the `langsmith-frontend`.
- [Mirror images for your LangSmith installation](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-mirroring-images.md): By default, LangSmith will pull images from our public Docker registry.
- [View trace counts across your organization](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-organization-charts.md): This feature is available on Helm chart versions 0.9.5 and later.
- [Use environment variables for model providers](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-playground-environment-settings.md): This feature is only available on Helm chart versions 0.10.27 (application version 0.10.74) and later.
- [Configure LangSmith for scale](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-scale.md): The scaling guidance and example configurations on this page apply to **LangSmith version v0.13.0 or higher**.
- [Set up SSO with OAuth2.0 and OIDC](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-sso.md): LangSmith [Self-Hosted](/langsmith/self-hosted) provides SSO via OAuth2.0 and OIDC, which delegates authentication to your Identity Provider (IdP) to manage access to LangSmith.
- [AWS Terraform architecture](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-architecture.md): Understand what the [AWS Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/aws) provision and how the pieces fit together, so you can size, secure,…
- [Deploy LangSmith on AWS with Terraform](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-deploy.md): Deploy LangSmith to AWS with the public [Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/aws).
- [AWS Terraform quick reference](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-quick-reference.md): Command cheat sheet for day-to-day operations against an AWS LangSmith deployment provisioned with the [AWS Terraform…
- [AWS Terraform troubleshooting](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-troubleshooting.md): This page documents common issues, fixes, and diagnostic commands for LangSmith deployments provisioned with the [AWS Terraform…
- [AWS Terraform variables reference](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-aws-variables.md): Complete reference for every input variable exposed by the [AWS Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/aws).
- [Azure Terraform architecture](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-architecture.md): Understand what the [Azure Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/azure) provision and how the pieces fit together, so you can size,…
- [Deploy LangSmith on Azure with Terraform](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-deploy.md): Deploy LangSmith to Azure with the public [Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/azure).
- [Azure Terraform quick reference](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-quick-reference.md): Command cheat sheet for day-to-day operations against an Azure LangSmith deployment provisioned with the [Azure Terraform…
- [Azure Terraform troubleshooting](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-troubleshooting.md): This page documents common issues, fixes, and diagnostic commands for LangSmith deployments provisioned with the [Azure Terraform…
- [Azure Terraform variables reference](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-azure-variables.md): Complete reference for every input variable exposed by the [Azure Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/azure).
- [GCP Terraform architecture](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-architecture.md): Understand what the [GCP Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/gcp) provision and how the pieces fit together, so you can size, secure,…
- [Deploy LangSmith on GCP with Terraform](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-deploy.md): Deploy LangSmith to GCP with the public [Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/gcp).
- [GCP Terraform quick reference](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-quick-reference.md): Command cheat sheet for day-to-day operations against a GCP LangSmith deployment provisioned with the [GCP Terraform…
- [GCP Terraform troubleshooting](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-troubleshooting.md): This page documents common issues, fixes, and diagnostic commands for LangSmith deployments provisioned with the [GCP Terraform…
- [GCP Terraform variables reference](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform-gcp-variables.md): Complete reference for every input variable exposed by the [GCP Terraform modules](https://github.com/langchain-ai/terraform/tree/main/modules/gcp).
- [Deploy LangSmith with Terraform](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-terraform.md): Self-hosted LangSmith is an add-on to the Enterprise plan designed for LangChain's largest, most security-conscious customers.
- [Enable TTL and data retention](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ttl.md): LangSmith Self-Hosted allows enablement of automatic TTL and Data Retention of traces.
- [Customize the error support message](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-ui-customization.md): By default, error messages in LangSmith direct users to the [Support Portal](https://support.langchain.com). You can replace this with your own support contact information.
- [Upgrade an installation](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-upgrades.md): Downgrades are not officially supported. LangSmith upgrades may include database migrations and other changes that are not backward-compatible.
- [Interact with your self-hosted instance of LangSmith](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-usage.md): This guide will walk you through the process of using your self-hosted instance of LangSmith.
- [Customize user management](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-user-management.md): This guide assumes you have read the [admin guide](/langsmith/administration-overview) and [organization setup guide](/langsmith/set-up-hierarchy#set-up-an-organization).
- [Use an existing secret for your installation (Kubernetes)](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-host-using-an-existing-secret.md): By default, LangSmith will provision several Kubernetes secrets to store sensitive information such as license keys, salts, and other configuration parameters.
- [Agent Server metrics](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted-agent-server-metrics.md): The [Agent Server](/langsmith/agent-server) emits metrics through an OpenTelemetry (OTel) client. Metrics use the `lg_api_` name prefix by default (override with `METRIC_PREFIX`).
- [Self-hosted LangSmith changelog](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted-changelog.md): LangSmith Self-Hosted v0.16 is our recommended release for all self-hosted deployments.
- [Install Mission Control](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted-mission-control.md): Mission Control is an in-cluster console for monitoring, configuring, and operating LangSmith on Kubernetes.
- [Self-hosted platform features](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted-platform-features.md): This page describes the platform features that apply only to [self-hosted](/langsmith/self-hosted) deployments.
- [Self-hosted LangSmith](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/self-hosted.md): Self-hosted LangSmith is an add-on to the Enterprise plan designed for our largest, most security-conscious customers.
- [How to add semantic search to your agent deployment](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/semantic-search.md): Semantic search lets your agent recall stored memories and documents by meaning rather than exact wording.
- [A2A endpoint in Agent Server](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/server-a2a.md): [Agent2Agent (A2A)](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/) is Google's protocol for enabling communication between conversational AI agents.
- [Agent Server API reference for LangSmith Deployment](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/server-api-ref.md): The Agent Server API reference is available within each [deployment](/langsmith/deployment) at the `/docs` endpoint (e.g. `http://localhost:8124/docs`).
- [MCP endpoint in Agent Server](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/server-mcp.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol for describing tools and data sources in a model-agnostic format, enabling LLMs to discover and use them via a structured API.
- [Trace JS functions in serverless environments](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/serverless-environments.md): This section is relevant for those using the LangSmith JS SDK version 0.2.0 and higher.
- [Set up custom authentication](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/set-up-custom-auth.md): In this tutorial, we will build a chatbot that only lets specific users access it. We'll start with the LangGraph template and add token-based security step by step.
- [Set up feedback criteria](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/set-up-feedback-criteria.md): For continuous feedback, you can enter a feedback tag name, then select a minimum and maximum value.
- [Set up hierarchy](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/set-up-hierarchy.md): This page describes setting up and managing your LangSmith [_organization_](/langsmith/administration-overview#organizations) and…
- [Set up resource tags](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/set-up-resource-tags.md): Resource tags are available for [Plus and Enterprise plans](/langsmith/pricing-plans).
- [How to set up an application with requirements.txt](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/setup-app-requirements-txt.md): An application must be configured with a [configuration file](/langsmith/cli#configuration-file) in order to be deployed to LangSmith (or to be self-hosted).
- [How to set up a JavaScript application](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/setup-javascript.md): An application must be configured with a [configuration file](/langsmith/cli#configuration-file) in order to be deployed to LangSmith (or to be self-hosted).
- [How to set up an application with pyproject.toml](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/setup-pyproject.md): An application must be configured with a [configuration file](/langsmith/cli#configuration-file) in order to be deployed to LangSmith (or to be self-hosted).
- [LangSmith shared responsibility model](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/shared-responsibility-model.md): LangSmith is a multi-tenant SaaS product.
- [LangSmith skills](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/skills.md): Agent Skills are reusable, on‑demand capabilities that bundle instructions plus optional helper scripts.
- [LangSmith API reference](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/smith-api-ref.md): The LangSmith REST API provides programmatic access to LangSmith platform features including tracing, datasets, experiments, annotations, and more.
- [Migrate dataset experiment runs to SmithDB](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/smithdb-sdk-migration-experiments.md): These methods query the runs attached to a dataset experiment.
- [Migrate feedback and sharing methods to SmithDB](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/smithdb-sdk-migration-feedback.md): These methods add runs to annotation queues, share runs publicly, and create feedback.
- [Migrate run queries to SmithDB](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/smithdb-sdk-migration-query-runs.md): Run queries are the largest surface area in the migration, so they have their own page.
- [Migrate run retrieval to SmithDB](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/smithdb-sdk-migration-runs.md): These methods read a single run or build a link to one. To migrate run queries, see [Query runs](/langsmith/smithdb-sdk-migration-query-runs).
